data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 83.1m (2013: GBP 59.1m) is an improvement of GBP 6.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end. This favourable loss development is spread across multiple classes of business and years of account and is caused by both attritional losses not developing as originally anticipated and improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves.

prior_year_events.impact_description: resolution of certain legacy issues has had an appreciable favourable impact on incurred claims
attritional losses not developing as originally anticipated
improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 6.4 million in prior year reserves, representing a 3.49% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was attributed to attritional losses not developing as anticipated and improvements in previously held catastrophe loss reserves. The most significant favorable development occurred on the 2012 year of account, particularly in the Property (Direct & Facultative) class, and also across Marine (Hull & Liability) and Starr Tech Onshore classes. The resolution of certain legacy issues also contributed positively.
